input_types.b_t: binary graph-label map with max 2 occurrences per tetrahedron
input_types.X_t: typed packet burden, phase, framing and closure states
input_types.R_av_t: additive available resource in an independently defined unit; OPEN
input_types.H_t: retained causal/event history and versioned ownership

transitions.name: enumerate
transitions.rule: frontier face with incidence=1 and unique deficient binary label

transitions.name: prepare
transitions.rule: source-derived full newborn X, U, metric/normal and signed receipt

transitions.name: fund
transitions.rule: R_av>=C_form>0, where C_form is independent of M_form viability threshold

transitions.name: authorize
transitions.rule: prior-state source-selected face, event index, collision arbitration, or explicit HOLD

transitions.name: commit
transitions.rule: add one fresh vertex, three edges, three triangles and one tetrahedron, with shared-face ownership and typed ledger

transitions.name: retract
transitions.rule: separately authorized inverse with signed refund and any leakage receipt

conditions.conservation: delta(R_free+R_bound+R_out-R_in)=0 in one declared additive unit
source_not_predictions: J23 after a registered cell exists
conditions.symmetry_gate: cannot deterministically choose a singleton facet from a fully symmetric decorated seed without additional asymmetry
